title: Steam
description: Short lines of type made of steam on a dark ground, a few words at a time like a lyric video. Each line gathers out of a haze, breathes thin strands upward while it holds, then lifts away for the next. Move across the words to blow them apart; they swirl, thin, and pull themselves back together.
intent: Type you can blow on: the words are the steam, drawn from a velocity field that forgets you a second later.

sources.name: Bruno Simon, My Room in 3D, coffee steam
sources.what: Read for the idea only (no licence): steam as noise scrolling upward with sway that grows with height. Re-derived as strands rising from a blurred text mask, warped by drifting noise.

sources.name: OGL, Flowmap
sources.what: The flowmap technique: a 128 square ping-pong field that decays each frame, a velocity stamp with a smoothstep falloff around the pointer, pointer velocity eased in at 0.5 and out at 0.1. Re-implemented in three.js with time-based decay and an upward drift; the type is sampled upstream of the flow so it bends and thins along your breath.

sources.name: three.js
sources.what: Render targets, data textures and the full-screen shader passes.
